answer_1.quote: we propose an LLM-based multi-agent system, Virtual Scientists (VIRSCI), designed to harness the potential of LLM agents in assisting autonomous scientific idea generation.

answer_2.quote: we adopt a more objective approach by using three common metrics that align with our intuition... Historical Dissimilarity (HD)... Contemporary Dissimilarity (CD)... Contemporary Impact (CI)... Overall Novelty (ON).

answer_3.quote: The LLM review score is calculated by GPT-4o, which conducts abstract reviews based on a truncated version of the Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) conference review guidelines.

answer_4.quote: We additionally conduct a human evaluation to assess novelty, feasibility, and effectiveness besides our proposed metrics and LLM review score... independent researchers assessed each abstract.
answer_4.guideline: Human experts rated abstracts on a 10-point scale based on three metrics: Novelty, Feasibility, and Effectiveness.
